source_rules.source: official DTU calibrated rectified collection, lighting 3, same registered source/target cameras and use rights
source_rules.eligibility: New physical subject with all ten required frames and finite compatible calibrations, independently documented identity, required rights and accessible within a separately registered storage/transfer budget. Exclude set1/set6, previously exposed subjects, rotation variants and ambiguous or duplicate physical subjects. Log every exclusion from catalogue evidence.
source_rules.ordering: Sort eligible official scan IDs as integers ascending; retain the lowest ID of each independently established physical family. A future confirmation takes the first up to six eligible families, reports a shortfall below four, and preserves failures.

roles.T0: first up to six new eligible independent physical families by integer scan ID, with documented official mapping; keep all post-registration failures

allowed_reads_before_reference_opening: condition-specific source photographs and their self-renders, registered camera geometry, frozen models and derived target RGB/Z/alpha predictions; no target photographs, reference scans or object boxes
initialization: apply frozen source-only eligibility; otherwise run the original 2048 ray hypotheses in endpoint_stratified_inverse_depth. Failure to triangulate is reported separately from final failure.
D_fixture: only one complete forced fallback fit on set1 M2, never inspect its target reference or error; exclude this fit from T0

evaluation.label: float32 mean absolute three-channel difference of display-sRGB, strictly > float32(0.05)
evaluation.primary_domain: full 256x256 center crop; predicted alpha does not mask RGB labels
evaluation.ranking: within_new = E intersect finite score of all four released methods; AP paired with prevalence over exactly those defined views
evaluation.matched_coverage: recover original per-view q% of V (1,2,5,10,20,40,60,80), same exact-k rounding, hash-seeded PCG64 tie ranks over the whole grid, and nominal MS-L1 anchor; no old-version comparator on new objects
evaluation.aggregation: six views per condition; show pooled numerators and denominators, mean of defined view AP with companion mean prevalence. Compare M2 and M4 separately across equally weighted physical objects; provide defined object/view counts. No imputation of missing MAE.
evaluation.unknown: E without finite method score; missing prediction reduces E, missing reference implies unknown V. Count all scheduled methods and objects in system completion.
evaluation.opening: require the complete frozen object x condition matrix; for each expected view require all four original score maps bound to its native prediction or a sealed terminal failure receipt. Once per whole study, by independent evaluator. No substitution or performance-triggered retry.

rights: Official DTU photographs and derived imagery stay private; share original software, authored example, citations, identities and numerical summaries.
